nodes.summary: At an actual ambient cutoff, lifting reflects as well as preserves canonical name scoping. It is not a second scope definition.
nodes.title: Lifting preserves and reflects name scoping

nodes.summary: An input is exposed outside every communication guard.
nodes.title: Unguarded input in a process

nodes.summary: Every existing structural congruence preserves exposed input presence.
nodes.title: Structural congruence preserves unguarded inputs

nodes.summary: Selection cannot hide an input that is present in its selected term.
nodes.title: Selection reflects unguarded inputs

nodes.summary: Binder lifting cannot identify two physical names.
nodes.title: Injectivity of name lifting

nodes.summary: Lifting commutes with entering the innermost name binder.
nodes.title: Commuting a name lift past a lift at cutoff zero

nodes.summary: Arbitrary-cutoff lift fusion, including the cutoffs reached under input and restriction binders.
nodes.title: Commutation of name lifts at ordered cutoffs

nodes.summary: Existing outer names cannot become the fresh innermost binder.
nodes.title: A lifted name is never the innermost binder

nodes.summary: A lifted outer key can never be either freshly bound role at var zero.
nodes.title: A lifted key is never a freshly bound key

nodes.summary: Lift fusion throughout existing π syntax, at arbitrary ordered cutoffs.
nodes.title: Commutation of process lifts at ordered cutoffs

nodes.summary: The inserted name is absent from every position of the actual lifted π term, including payloads and all nested input/restriction binders.
nodes.title: The inserted name is absent from a lifted process

nodes.summary: The given physical name occurs in no subject, payload or continuation position. Existing binders shift the tracked outer name with canonical lift.
nodes.title: Absence of a physical name from a process

nodes.summary: A transmitted endpoint payload is an occurrence, even when completed.
nodes.title: An output payload name is not absent

nodes.summary: Every existing π step requires an exposed input in its source, including pre-congruence, selection, context closure and replication folding.
nodes.title: Every π step source has an unguarded input

nodes.summary: Substitution removes an inserted binder without changing its shifted outer names. The inserted binder's replacement is arbitrary.
nodes.title: Substitution cancels name lifting

nodes.summary: Removing an inserted binder cancels lifting throughout the unchanged π syntax, including nested inputs, restrictions, choice and replication.
nodes.title: Substitution cancels process lifting

nodes.summary: Swapping existing binders cannot identify physical names.
nodes.title: Injectivity of name swapping

nodes.summary: Swapping the same two existing binders twice restores a name.
nodes.title: Name swap is an involution

nodes.summary: Existing process swapping is likewise involutive under every binder.
nodes.title: Process swap is an involution

nodes.summary: An unused completed endpoint may be added through every current typing constructor. Scope and freshness are explicit; active weakening is not admitted.
nodes.title: Weakening by an unused completed endpoint

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
